name: pacing
description: Stamina-gated movement pacing. A walk cadence (short per-step cooldown via a registerMoveGate veto) throttles direction-spamming so the large map feels large, while a `sprint` toggle spends stamina per step for a faster burst cadence and drops you to 'winded' below a floor. System moves (opts.bypassEncumbrance) are exempt. Spend + HUD push happen on the zone.entered event.
